Customer.title: Customer
Customer.description: Represents a customer of M.C & SONS FISH COMPANY.

active.description: Indicates whether the customer is active.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the customer was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of when the customer was last updated.

User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user of the billing system.

active.description: Indicates whether the user is active.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the user was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of when the user was last updated.

Product.title: Product
Product.description: Represents a product sold by M.C & SONS FISH COMPANY.

uomAllowed.description: Allowed units of measure for the product (BOX, KGS, ITEMS, NOS).

active.description: Indicates whether the product is active.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the product was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of when the product was last updated.

name.description: The name of the Unit of Measure (e.g., KGS, BOX).

Payment.title: Payment
Payment.description: Represents a payment received from a customer.

date.description: Timestamp of when the payment was made.

CustomerBalance.title: CustomerBalance
CustomerBalance.description: Represents the opening balance of a customer.

balanceAmount.description: The opening balance amount for the customer.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of when the balance was last updated.

ProductPrice.title: ProductPrice
ProductPrice.description: Represents the price of a product for a specific date and unit of measure.

priceDate.description: The date for which the price is valid.

uom.description: Unit of measure for the price (BOX, KGS, ITEMS, NOS).

pricePerUom.description: The price per unit of measure.

Bill.title: Bill
Bill.description: Represents a bill for a customer.

createdBy.description: Reference to User who created the bill. (Relationship: User 1:N Bill)

stall.description: The stall number for the bill.

totalAmount.description: The total amount of the bill.

deliveryCharge.description: Optional delivery charge for the bill.

status.description: The status of the bill (OPEN, PRINTED, CLOSED).

BillItem.title: BillItem
BillItem.description: Represents an item in a bill.

billItemId.description: Unique identifier for the bill item.

uom.description: Unit of measure for the bill item.

addedBy.description: Reference to User who added the bill item. (Relationship: User 1:N BillItem)

addedAt.description: Timestamp of when the bill item was added.

BillArchive.title: BillArchive
BillArchive.description: Represents an archived bill (same structure as Bill and BillItem).

billId.description: Unique identifier for the archived bill.

billDate.description: The date of the archived bill.

createdBy.description: Reference to User who created the archived bill. (Relationship: User 1:N BillArchive)

stall.description: The stall number for the archived bill.

totalAmount.description: The total amount of the archived bill.

totalQtyBox.description: Total quantity in boxes for the archived bill.

totalQtyKgs.description: Total quantity in kilograms for the archived bill.

totalQtyItems.description: Total quantity in items for the archived bill.

totalQtyNos.description: Total quantity in numbers for the archived bill.

status.description: The status of the archived bill (OPEN, PRINTED, CLOSED).

billItems.description: A list of bill items associated with the archived bill. (Relationship: BillArchive 1:N BillItem)

Vehicle.title: Vehicle
Vehicle.description: Represents a vehicle used for transport.

id.description: Unique identifier for the vehicle (Registration Number).

name.description: Name or model of the vehicle.

active.description: Indicates whether the vehicle is active.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the vehicle was added.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of when the vehicle was last updated.

active.description: Indicates whether the driver is active.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the driver was added.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of when the driver was last updated.

Party.title: Party
Party.description: Represents a party or a destination for vehicle trips.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the party was added.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of when the party was last updated.

VehicleBill.title: VehicleBill
VehicleBill.description: Represents a bill for a vehicle trip.

id.description: Unique identifier for the vehicle bill.

date.description: The date of the vehicle bill.

partyName.description: Denormalized name of the party for display.

createdBy.description: Reference to User who created the bill.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the bill was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of when the bill was last updated.

firestore.reasoning:
The Firestore structure is designed to support the M.C & SONS FISH COMPANY billing system, focusing on real-time multi-user collaboration, role-based access control, and efficient data retrieval. The structure adheres to the principles of Authorization Independence, Structural Segregation, Access Modeling, and Data Clarity.

**Authorization Independence:**
Authorization is enforced using a combination of path-based ownership and denormalized data. For instance, `Bill` documents are stored under `/bills/{billId}`, with the `createdBy` field referencing the `User` who created the bill. Although the `createdBy` is present, authorization rules do not depend on fetching the user document. Instead, the presence of a `User` document with a matching `userId` can determine access.

**Structural Segregation:**
Data with different access needs is segregated into separate collections. For example, `Customer` and `Product` data are stored in their respective top-level collections (`/customers` and `/products`), each with specific security rules tailored to their content. Archived bills are stored in a separate collection (`/billArchives`), allowing for different retention policies and potentially different access controls compared to active bills.

**Access Modeling:**
Ownership is modeled using path-based access control for user-owned data.  `Bill` documents include the `createdBy` field. Role-based access control is implemented using the `/roles_admin/{uid}` collection for admin users.

**QAPs (Rules are not Filters):**
The structure supports secure `list` operations by enforcing security rules directly on the queried collections. For example, listing `Bill` documents can be secured by checking the user's role or the `createdBy` field of the documents, without relying on filtering after retrieval.

**Invariants:**
The structure supports the integrity of ownership, timestamps, and denormalized data. Timestamps like `createdAt` and `updatedAt` are enforced on `Customer`, `User`, and `Product` documents to maintain data consistency. The `createdBy` field in the `Bill` collection ensures the integrity of bill ownership.

This design ensures a secure, scalable, and debuggable Firestore structure for the M.C & SONS FISH COMPANY billing system, facilitating efficient data management and real-time collaboration.
